commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Goro-Goro and Satoru ({U}{B}{R} 3/4 legendary Goblin Human; March of the Machine Commander, set moc, released 2023-04-21; commander-legal, not a Game Changer, no project exception). Whenever one or more creatures we control that entered this turn deal combat damage to a player, create a 5/5 flying Dragon Spirit; {1}{R}: our creatures gain haste. Plan (owner blueprint 2026-10-14): cheap evasive or hasty entrants, ninjutsu/sneak entrants (Silver-Fur Master, Yuriko, Satoru Umezawa, Raphael), repeatable token engines (Daring Piracy, Fire Navy Trebuchet, Determined Iteration, Loyal Apprentice, Urabrask's Forge), continuous haste (Samut, Frostcliff Siege, Dragon Tempest for flyers), combat draw (Bident, Enduring Curiosity, Grazilaxx, Waterbender Ascension) and extra combats (Breath of Fury, Karlach, Great Train Heist, Aggravated Assault). Bitterblossom adds a fresh flying Faerie Rogue every upkeep.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 (Optimized), unchanged. Game Changers: 6 in baseline and candidate (Ancient Tomb, Cyclonic Rift, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship, Jeska's Will, Vampiric Tutor). Commander Spellbook find-my-combos: 5 -> 5 complete combos, all Breath of Fury loops needing the enchanted creature to connect each combat (33-3259 Loyal Apprentice, 1347-3259 Urabrask's Forge, 2237-3259 Goro-Goro and Satoru, 3259-3934 Determined Iteration, 1674-3259 Daring Piracy); almost-included 142 -> 138. No compact two-card instant win; the owner rejected a turbo-combo conversion.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first to Goro's Oracle: the add creates exactly the 'entered this turn' attacker the trigger needs every turn and survives creature sweepers. Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the most similar approved Grixis decks, baseline -> candidate, canonical Archidekt exports): Admiral Beckett Brass 45 -> 45; Garza Zol, Plague Queen 43 -> 43; Admiral Brass, Unsinkable 42 -> 42; Don Andres, the Renegade 41 -> 41; Doctor Doom, King of Latveria 41 -> 41. Neither Bitterblossom nor Mist-Syndicate Naga appears in those five decks; Bitterblossom appears only in the two Lord of Tresserhorn lists. No other Grixis deck is Ninja-led; the deck stays a fresh-attacker / Ninja Dragon engine built on Goro's own Oracle. Owner-removed or rejected cards and classes (Reinforced Ronin, Rising of the Day, Feed the Swarm, Combat Research, Impact Tremors, Kaito, Dancing Shadow, Kaito, Cunning Infiltrator, Higure, Dokuchi Silencer, Throat Slitter, Orochi Soul-Reaver, Moonsnare Specialist, Alora, Mist-Cloaked Herald, Tin Street Dodger, Tormented Soul, Invisible Stalker, Enduring Courage, Urabrask the Hidden, Fervor, Blade of Selves, Lagomos, Sokenzan, Secret Tunnel, Access Tunnel, generic Thoracle/Breach turbo-combo) are not re-added.

All 99 library cards (98 rows; 2x Island) were reviewed by quantity.
Roles:
- 33 lands: Ancient Tomb, Badlands, Blood Crypt, Bloodstained Mire, City of Brass, Command Tower, Crumbling Necropolis, Drowned Catacomb, Exotic Orchard, Fabled Passage, 2 Island, Luxury Suite, Mana Confluence, Morphic Pool, Mountain, Otawara, Soaring City, Polluted Delta, Rogue's Passage, Scalding Tarn, Shipwreck Marsh, Shivan Reef, Steam Vents, Stormcarved Coast, Sulfur Falls, Sulfurous Springs, Swamp, Training Center, Underground River, Underground Sea, Volcanic Island, Watery Grave, Xander's Lounge.
- Mana rocks: Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone, three Talismans.
- Fresh entrants and Ninjas: Slither Blade, Triton Shorestalker, Changeling Outcast, Gingerbrute, Phoenix Chick, Ragavan, Tetsuko, Silver-Fur Master, Moon-Circuit Hacker, Ninja of the Deep Hours, Mistblade Shinobi, Prosperous Thief, Thousand-Faced Shadow, Fallen Shinobi, Nashi, Sakashima's Student, Yuriko, Satoru Umezawa, Satoru, the Infiltrator, Ingenious Infiltrator, Raphael, Mist-Syndicate Naga (cut).
- Token/haste engines: Daring Piracy, Fire Navy Trebuchet, Determined Iteration, Loyal Apprentice, Urabrask's Forge, Samut, Frostcliff Siege, Dragon Tempest, Lightning Greaves; Bitterblossom is new.
- Payoffs and draw: Terror of the Peaks, Bident of Thassa, Enduring Curiosity, Grazilaxx, Waterbender Ascension, Grim Hireling, Professional Face-Breaker, Kaito, Bane of Nightmares.
- Extra combats: Breath of Fury, Karlach, Great Train Heist, Aggravated Assault, Jeska's Will (mana).
- Interaction: Counterspell, Mana Drain, Arcane Denial, Swan Song, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Cyclonic Rift, Chaos Warp, Terminate, Withering Torment, Deadly Rollick, Toxic Deluge, Vandalblast.
- Tutors: Demonic Tutor, Vampiric Tutor.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Unchanged by the swap. 33 lands; U/B/R sources (fetches, Fabled Passage and rainbow lands counted per colour) 25/21/21; 66 nonland; curve MV1 13, MV2 21 -> 22, MV3 19 -> 18, MV4 10, MV5 3; average nonland MV 2.53 -> 2.52; creatures 31 -> 30 (Bitterblossom makes one each turn). Exact enumeration of paid {U}{B}{R} on turn 3: play 0.6668, draw 0.7456 in both lists; Fellwar Stone challenge (non-mana placeholder) 0.6452 / 0.7254, so the rock stays.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Counterspell, Mana Drain, Arcane Denial, Swan Song, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, An Offer You Can't Refuse. Removal: Terminate, Withering Torment, Deadly Rollick, Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Toxic Deluge, Vandalblast. Resilience gain: Bitterblossom is an enchantment, so after a creature sweeper or commander removal it keeps producing fresh flying attackers (bounded sweeper row 3 vs Naga's 2 Dragons, and it leaves the engine on board). Weak points: flying blockers stop lone Faeries; Bitterblossom's life drain; Goro tax after removal.

material_candidates.role: {1}{B} Kindred Enchantment — Faerie: each upkeep lose 1 life and create a 1/1 black Faerie Rogue with flying.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Mist-Syndicate Naga ({2}{U} 3/1 Ninja, ninjutsu {2}{U}; copies itself when it deals combat damage). Naga is a plain retained card, NOT among the owner's explicitly kept Ninja list (2026-10-14). Its copy is made after combat damage, so it never helps that combat's Goro trigger (ruling 2019-06-14 / CR 603.2). EDHREC 984/8913 general, 11/188 optimized (synergy 0.11 / 0.06).
material_candidates.commander_synergy: A repeatable fresh evasive attacker every one of our turns, which is the commander's Oracle condition ('creatures that entered this turn'): Dragon Tempest gives flying entrants haste for free; Tetsuko makes the 1/1 unblockable; it is a Rogue for Silver-Fur Master and Prosperous Thief; Determined Iteration can populate it; it supplies Breath of Fury receivers and ninjutsu fodder. As an enchantment it survives creature sweepers and commander removal. Bounded Pass C ledger: Dragons made >= Naga in 9 of 10 scripted rows (lean open 4 vs 2, sweeper 3 vs 2, extra combat 6 vs 3; engine open 8 vs 6, extra 11 vs 9).
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Costs 1 life per turn (5 life by turn 7 in the ledger; mandatory even at 1 life, ruling 2008-04-01); a lone 1/1 flyer is stopped by a flying blocker (lean flyer-wall row: 0 Dragons vs Naga's 2, which come from the generic ninjutsu entry, not the copy); needs haste (Dragon Tempest, Samut, Frostcliff Temur or Goro's {1}{R}) to attack the turn it is made. Loses one ninjutsu body for Satoru Umezawa / Yuriko lines.
material_candidates.reason: Pass C's own NEEDS TESTING request was run as a finite ledger; Bitterblossom beat or tied the weakest non-owner-kept candidate cut in 9 of 10 rows and matches the owner's stated support plan ('repeatable beginning-of-combat or attack-token engines'). Pass C's named cuts (Bident, Grazilaxx) and the deep review's example (Frostcliff Siege) are staged and rejected.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: One one-for-one swap: Bitterblossom for Mist-Syndicate Naga. Losses: a ninjutsu body (fewer Satoru Umezawa / Yuriko / Silver-Fur Master ninjutsu lines), 1 life per turn, and a lone Faerie is stopped by a flying blocker. Mana base, curve band and castability are unchanged. No owner keep or owner addition is cut.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C NEEDS TESTING (baseline vs +Bitterblossom -Bident of Thassa and vs +Bitterblossom -Grazilaxx, Illithid Scholar) was run as a bounded deterministic ledger: turns 1-7, paid turn-3 Goro, lean and engine (Daring Piracy) profiles, open / flying-blocker wall / Goro removal turn 5 / sweeper turn 6 / one extra combat (Great Train Heist turn 6). Bitterblossom made 0-11 Dragons; Bident drew 2-23 cards and Grazilaxx 2-11 while adding Dragons only in engine rows. Cutting either owner-valued draw engine is not clearly better, so both Pass C lists are staged and rejected; the same Bitterblossom instead replaces Mist-Syndicate Naga, which the ledger shows contributing fewer Dragons in 9 of 10 rows. Matched-game win rates were not run: no validated Goro game model exists.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The baseline has no fresh-attacker source that survives a creature sweeper or works without mana each turn; Mist-Syndicate Naga's distinctive copy ability is timed after combat damage and so never feeds the commander's trigger in the combat it connects.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: One genuine swap: Bitterblossom for Mist-Syndicate Naga. No second genuine improvement was found without cutting an owner keep on unclear evidence (Bident, Grazilaxx, Crumbling Necropolis), re-adding an owner-rejected class (more one-drop evasive bodies) or making a marginal role trade (Redoubled Stormsinger, Rapid Hybridization), so the deck is held as research only.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Commander first, then lines alphabetically; 2x Island, every other card 1x. One substitution against the canonical source. 33 lands; 100 physical cards verified by quantity (99 library + 1 commander).

withdrawal_reason: RESEARCH_ONLY: only one genuine swap was found (Bitterblossom over Mist-Syndicate Naga). The five-swap owner-presentation floor is not met without padding: every other candidate either cuts an owner keep on evidence that does not clearly beat it (Bident of Thassa, Grazilaxx, Illithid Scholar, Crumbling Necropolis), re-adds a class the owner rejected (more one-drop evasive bodies), or is a marginal role trade (Redoubled Stormsinger, Rapid Hybridization). This packet is NOT owner-presentable and NOT owner approved; the canonical Goro-Goro and Satoru list is unchanged.
